A '''nerve regenerator''' was a medical tool that could be used to perform emergency field surgery. The [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpac]] from [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] included a nerve regenerator.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
